description: Agent Commerce Hunter — Search customer-authorized eBay offers OR inspect one caller-supplied public product page without an eBay key when source_mode=public_page; compare prices only for actual offers, and optionally read stock signals through extract/product-check, retrieve published return-policy excerpts and calculate order contribution using caller-supplied sale price and goods cost. One x402 charge covers the composed workflow; missing evidence remains explicit. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

comparison_url.description: Optional public product page for product-check and extract stock signals

currency.description: Same ISO currency code for all profit figures, required when profit is requested

platform_fee_pct.description: Optional percentage fee on selling price

policy_url.description: Optional public returns policy page; text excerpts, not eligibility decision

query.description: Exact product model or sourcing query; eBay search requires X-Provider-Key, public_page does not

selling_price.description: Customer assumed selling price per order; required with unit_cost

shipping_cost.description: Optional per-order shipping and packing cost

source_mode.description: Optional ebay (default) or public_page; public_page requires comparison_url and does not search marketplace offers

unit_cost.description: Customer known goods cost per order; required with selling_price

name: api_agent_commerce_hunter
